messages:
Kelsey P (Product): quick async pulse — need concise status for the Q2 OKR milestone check. One-line per area: What shipped, what slipped, owner, next step. please drop by EOD Thu. cc @Alex G @Mai S

Alex G (Eng Runtime): shipped: kernel selection merged, perf baseline added to bench infra (PR #4567). preliminary numbers look good (~20k tok/s for 2xA100). next: canary config for Dedicated. owner: Alex. :shipit:

Mai S (Eng Platform): slipped: autoscaler policy implementation at ~60%. blocker is the GKE node image conflict with our custom driver. pairing with infra next. owner: Mai.

Jordan R (Eng SRE): ACK. Node image freeze lifted; I'll open infra ticket and coordinate a rolling remediation. ETA ~48h.

Sam H (PM): product note — header-based routing request from pilot customers is out-of-scope this quarter. mark as stretch. we prefer the canary first.

Kelsey P (Product): noted, thanks. ask: owners, please add a one-line commit/status in the doc and ping here when done. I'll roll into the consolidated status for exec readout.

Alex G (Eng Runtime): pinging eng-runtime reviewers — need 2 reviewers on the perf PRs. @Mai S can you take a look at CI flakes? small change to batching defaults needs a sanity check.

Mai S (Eng Platform): on it. found a flaky test in nightly; workaround pushed to CI config. will submit batching defaults PR today.

TriageBot: friendly reminder — Q2 milestone updates due by 1700 PT Thu. Docs: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/okr/q2-milestones

Jordan R (Eng SRE): FYI — canary capacity for Dedicated ramp requires +2 A100s for the first week; finance pre-approved a temporary bump.

Sam H (PM): great — if Alex can finalize canary config, we'll notify pilot customers and schedule the first run.

Alex G (Eng Runtime): will finalize canary flags today. quick config snippet:
```
canary:
  replicas: 2
  gpu: a100
  batch_window_ms: 8
```
I'll post PR link when ready.

Kelsey P (Product): perfect. last ask: if anything needs leadership escalation (budget, timeline risk), DM me. otherwise, owners update doc + ping here. thanks all :thumbsup:

Mai S (Eng Platform): updated doc: shipped items + known slips. link: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/okr/q2-milestones#milestone-runtime-v3

Alex G (Eng Runtime): marked shipped + added PR refs. will follow up with canary PR shortly.

Jordan R (Eng SRE): opened infra ticket #8901 for node image migration. assigning to infra-owner.

Sam H (PM): noted — I'll coordinate a short customer communication after canary is green.

Kelsey P (Product): thanks everyone — this is enough for the async roundup. I'll compile and circulate by EOD Thu.
